description: This Claude + Higgsfield AI Workflow Just Replaced a $100k/yr Creative Strategist 🤯
transcript: Claude plus Hicksville AI workflow just replaced Creative Strategist and it's absolutely insane. Most brands think AI UDC starts with an Avatar. That's wrong. It starts with research. First you pull the market's actual language from Reddit, TikTok, Amazon reviews, comments, competitor reviews, and organic videos. What did they hate? What are they skeptical about? What do they wish existed, and what words do they keep repeating? That becomes your creative brief. Then you give the research to Claude. Claude turns it into hooks, drips, scene direction, text overlays, objections, product angles, and CTAs. Now you were not guessing, you were building ads from customer language directly. Then you generate a hyper realistic Avatar holding the product, not some fake looking template. A specific creator that matches the buyer demographic. And Hicksville keeps that same Avatar in every scene. So scene one is a hook. Scene 2 problem. Scene 3 product reveal. Scene 4 the result. Scene 5 a CTA. Then the supercomputer stitches the scenes into a full UGC ad. Now you have an AI creator reading a research back script showing the product moving through B roll and scenes and delivering the exact angle that you want. This is the replacement. And now you can create 20 to 30 unique UGC concepts in a single day with different avatars, hooks, rejection scenes, and CTAs. Then you launch the winners, read the data, and then turn the best angles into more AI UGC videos. That is the new Creative system comment UGC and I'll send you the full playbook.
